offer.text: The main fight's done but stragglers still lurk in the alleys and cellars. Sweep the village and put down six of them before they regroup.

accept.text: Check the dark corners. That's where they hide.

decline.text: Then we'll be jumping at shadows all night.

in_progress.text: Found any of the stragglers yet?

ready.text: Six rooted out of the alleys. The streets are clean.

complete.text: Thorough as always. The village can breathe again. Well swept.
